title: Greenhouse Review (2026)
intro: Greenhouse is evaluated here as an applicant tracking / recruiting (ATS) platform — Greenhouse is a structured-hiring ATS/CRM from sourcing through offer and onboarding, with interview kits, scorecards, scheduling, and recruiting analytics. Named plans are Core, Plus, and Pro. Cost is custom-quote — influenced by plan, hiring volume, organizational complexity, and features. No free plan or self-serve trial (demo). AI features (notetaker, suggestions, Voice AI, Real Talent) are marketed and often tier-gated. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Greenhouse when structured hiring is the job and you will take a custom ATS quote — not when you need a free SMB ATS, a core HRIS, or payroll.
verdict: Choose Greenhouse when structured hiring is the job and you will take a custom ATS quote — not when you need a free SMB ATS, a core HRIS, or payroll. Compare Breezy HR for transparent SMB ATS pricing, Workable for published ATS floors with light HR, Ashby/Lever as ATS peers, and BambooHR if the real job is core HRIS. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Structured hiring is powerful and process-heavy versus SMB ATS tools. Score reflects mid-market/enterprise ATS admin overhead, not lab testing.
Primary job is ATS/recruiting — Greenhouse is the category-standard structured-hiring shortlist name. Scored inside ATS peers only.
Interview kits, scorecards, scheduling, CRM, and offer/onboarding workflows are deep. Held at 9 vs the most customized enterprise TA suites.
Hundreds of pre-built HRIS, LinkedIn, scheduling, background-check, and Slack connectors plus BI/API on higher tiers.
Recruiter/hiring-manager mobility exists; this is not deskless WFM. Scored for recruiting mobility only.
Recruiting analytics and AI report filters are a published strength on Plus+ packaging.
Core → Plus → Pro plus volume-based quotes support mid-market through enterprise hiring orgs.
Opaque custom quotes and implementation extras depress value versus transparent ATS floors (Breezy/Workable). Affiliate economics excluded.
AI Notetaker, suggestions, Voice AI, and governed MCP are marketed with tier gates — strong ATS AI story, not unlimited included AI.

faq.answer: Yes. Greenhouse is evaluated as an applicant tracking / recruiting (ATS) platform.
